pages.text: Link Ports with the $(l:power/binder)Conduit Binder$(/l). Each Port moves up to $(bold)500 kW$() either way. More Ports, more rate.$(br2)It charges from spare power and pays out when supply falls short. Reactors push to fill it.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: 20 MJ per cell.$(li)3x3x4: 640 MJ$(li)3x3x8: 1.36 GJ$(br2)Booting an Icarus takes about 70 MJ.

pages.title: The Cryocooler
pages.text: It runs on the silo's own charge, so a cold silo slowly drains itself. A grid outage never quenches it; it keeps itself cold until it runs empty.

pages.title: Drain
pages.text: A full silo loses, per hour:$(li)20C room: about 2%$(li)-45C: about 0.5%$(li)-120C: about 0.1%$(li)-180C or colder: nothing

pages.title: How Many Coolers
pages.text: Outdoors below 0C, one is enough at any height. In a 20C room, one holds a silo up to 4 tall; taller needs two.$(br2)Heat sources against the hull overwhelm any count.
